artifacts.notes: Exact PDF acquired and hashed in run-scoped temporary storage, then inspected by page image. PDF p. 72 displays fols. 68v and 69r; p. 81 displays fols. 77v and 78r; p. 128 displays fols. 124v and 125r; p. 129 displays fols. 125v and 126r. The scan has no text layer. PDF-page coordinates refer to this exact artifact, not printed pagination.
artifacts.rights_basis: The Jagiellonian Digital Library record states Domena publiczna (public domain) for this manuscript scan. The 110,899,733-byte official PDF is not duplicated in the repository.

edition.notes: The Jagiellonian Digital Library identifies the Latin manuscript as a pontifical and dates it to the eleventh or twelfth century. Manuscripta records parchment, 152 folios plus six preliminary folios, decoration, musical notation, and dimensions of 23 by 16 cm. These catalog facts and the manuscript images establish book identity and visible placement, not production place, local performance, frequency, normativity, textual descent, or relationship to the edited Pontificale Romano-Germanicum.
edition.title: Pontificale, Kraków, Biblioteka Jagiellońska, MS 2057

passages.context: The exact images place a recipient-oriented dossier from fol. 68v through the upper portion of fol. 77v. Its visible category headings distinguish a combined energumen/catechumen opening, a child described as an energumen, a baptized energumen, and an anointing unit for an energumen or sick person. A new major salt-and-water blessing begins lower on fol. 77v. This verifies categories, sequence, and book boundary only.
